title: Next-stage ancestry development and independent confirmation design
scope: Ancestry evaluation design only. No model acceptance, novelty, superiority or final-test result is presumed.

paired_candidate_minus_gru.scope: Repeatedly reused validation parents, one training seed, selected checkpoints and architecture. Historical NLL uses 1e-12 probability floor. Neither effect nor variance is a confirmatory estimate.

common_generation.demography: HomSap AncientEurope_4A21, stdpopsim0.3.0, unchanged for ID cohort
common_generation.coordinate_units: physical base pairs, model x=bp/1e6; rates per unit x; ages in generations

relate.coverage: [first exported original SNP, last exported original SNP + 1), retaining exact original midpoint grid; no tails
relate.genotypes: clean observed genealogy, no census truth
relate.polarization: simulated ancestral allele at observed sites

common_generation.split_unit: Independent parent simulation before windowing, genotype processing or subsampling
common_generation.input_boundary: Observed topology/estimated ages, genotypes for inference, stable sample correspondence, known reference cohort/source labels and sampling dates. Query source labels, internal populations, census nodes, truth segmentation, annotations and target readouts as sources are forbidden.

baseline_families: simple observed-reference predictor with physical-coordinate smoothing

simple_baseline_grid.fit: Train-only reference score/temperature fit, validation-only configuration choice

development.checkpoint_rule: Per configuration and seed: minimum equally weighted mean parent VAL uncalibrated NLL, earliest epoch tie. Select family configuration by mean selected-checkpoint VAL NLL across all 3 seeds. Baseline winner is smallest such value across baseline families. Ties within1e-4 nats: smaller parameter count, then predeclared lexicographic configuration ID.
development.training_inputs: Only64 fresh TRAIN parents; no refit on VAL in v1; previous pilots inform this explicit grid but are not added to training.
development.calibration: Optional temperature per selected model/seed fitted on16 VAL parents after checkpoint lock, preserved as secondary calibration analysis; primary NLL remains uncalibrated.
development.required_before_lock: Correctness and label-counterfactual checks, exact sample/coordinate alignment, baseline convergence curves and implementation scope, matched source/local controls, complete failure/admission ledger, raw-logit NLL/tract metric reader verified on development only.

confirmation.generation_time: After signed/hash-bound architecture, strongest baseline, selected3 checkpoints per model, metric/analysis code and secondary-contrast lock.
confirmation.attempt_order: Predeclared parent IDs0..191; use first160 label-blind admitted parents. Report all attempted IDs and reasons. If fewer160 admitted within192, analyze all admitted once and label precision shortfall.

primary.endpoint: Uncalibrated logit NLL at original128 uniform midpoints retained in observed inference coverage, averaged over all query haplotypes within each parent and over each seed's individual-model loss, then equally over parents.
primary.nll_computation: Float64 stable log-softmax/logsumexp from frozen logits; no hidden clipping. Preserve historical1e-12-floor NLL as compatibility diagnostic.

uncertainty.primary: Two-sided95% paired-parent t interval/test on d_i, df=N-1, alpha0.05
uncertainty.sensitivity: 10000 paired parent bootstrap resamples, same sampled IDs for every seed, method, query draw and condition; percentile95% interval with fixed analysis seed20261115
uncertainty.unit: Whole independent parent, never coordinates, tiles, queries or parent-seed cells
uncertainty.conditioning: Conditional on frozen development training sample and three fixed checkpoints; not a reliable estimate of general training-seed distribution.
uncertainty.seed_report: Three separate seed-specific mean differences, SD/range, per-parent3-seed vectors and failure rates. No seed with test-best score is selected.
uncertainty.conflict_rule: If paired t and parent bootstrap differ on sign exclusion, report sensitivity and do not describe a robust positive confirmation.

decision_labels.statistical_favorability: Primary95% t interval upper endpoint<0, with bootstrap sensitivity disclosed.
decision_labels.promising_but_practical_precision_insuff: Mean<=-0.010 and upper endpoint<0 but upper endpoint>=-0.010.
decision_labels.inconclusive: Interval includes0, or precision wider than intended; no superiority conclusion.
decision_labels.no_material_advantage_supported: Entire interval above-0.010 but not necessarily equivalence without a separately frozen equivalence test.

always: selected full candidate versus same-geometry/depth gain-matched diagonal
selected full candidate versus same-schema/depth static local control
secondary_contrasts.third_if_selected_age: age full versus capacity-matched scalar-age full, same depth
secondary_contrasts.third_else_if_selected_plain_depth2: contextual depth2 versus noncontextual depth2 query-source feedback control
secondary_contrasts.multiplicity: Holm family-wise alpha0.05 across eligible maximum3 two-sided paired-parent NLL tests. Report estimates and multiplicity-adjusted results whether or not primary is favorable. Other ablations are development/descriptive only.
secondary_contrasts.limitations: Gain-matched diagonal retains instantaneous source mixing. Static local preserves graph-local query mixing. None is a graph-free null.

dense_grid: 4096 fixed midpoint predictions with no new source anchors
switch count absolute error per haplotype
tract length distribution and class-specific errors
within10000bp of artificial tile edges versus interior
reporting_metrics.absent_class_rule: Missing truth or prediction denominator is NA with support0; retain all4 slots and disclose fixed-zero all4 macroF1 convention separately.
reporting_metrics.no_true_boundary_rule: Boundary recall/F1 undefined is NA with zero support; predicted false boundaries and switch error still reported.
reporting_metrics.illustrations: Select parent/window by hash-ranked IDs before outcomes, plus prespecified worst-loss diagnostic labeled selected.

checks: all declared sampled haplotypes preserved and aligned
valid physical coordinate map and nonempty observed SNP coverage
at least120 of128 original scoring points retained and coverage fraction>=0.95
full-parent electrical and canonicalization admissibility before tiling
finite strictly positive edge resistance and configured condition<=1e12
disallowed: dropping a tile/query/class after seeing score
data_admission.estimand: Performance conditional on label-blind admissibility. Report admission probability and excluded-parent resources separately.

failures.infrastructure: One same-seed same-config same-data retry, logged original failure, no alternate checkpoint or lower batch selected by outcomes.
failures.numerical_model: Failed configuration/seed is ineligible for development ranking unless deterministic shared bug corrected and entire affected family rerun before lock. Failure rate is reported.
failures.final: No replacement of failing method by runner-up. Any unresolved primary prediction failure prevents positive primary confirmation, with failure count and complete-case descriptive sensitivity reported. Numerical instability is a result, not a removable parent.
failures.shared_bug_after_unblinding: Declare v1 compromised; retain all original records/results. Fixes cannot turn the same cohort into a new confirmation.

heldout_access.before_lock: No confirmatory simulation, labels, genotypes, reconstructed graphs, derived geometry or model predictions generated/accessed.
heldout_access.after_lock_before_score: Custodian preparation may use truth solely for target extraction and integrity assertions. Development/modeling processes receive no labels/inputs/predictions, class counts or learned scores. Release only hashes, attempted/admitted counts, coverage, resource/numerical QA and reason codes. No source/model/analysis tuning follows.
heldout_access.prediction: Frozen evaluation runner consumes observed test inputs and selected checkpoint bundle once, no gradients/optimization; all seed/method predictions sealed before labels join.
heldout_access.analysis: One joined analysis/report execution after all predictions and admission ledger sealed; fully report primary, secondary, diagnostics, OOD and every failed attempt. Re-running to repair output formatting is allowed only on identical hashes/predictions, never for selection.

precision_sensitivity.formula: Illustrative95% halfwidth approximately1.975*assumed_SD/sqrt(160). No power guarantee or valid post-selection four-parent variance estimate.
precision_sensitivity.larger_sd_requirement: For assumedSD0.06, normal approximation requires about554 parents for halfwidth0.005, not160. No expansion after test outcome/variance inspection.
precision_sensitivity.purpose: 0.010 nats is about1% of exploratory NLL near1.04, a pragmatic usefulness threshold set by protocol rather than a universal biological standard.

reference_panels.subset: Nested hash selection of reference diploids, paired to the same underlying query truth; no class balancing by outcomes.
reference_panels.inference: Rerun Relate on retained observed reference/query genotypes, reconstruct common target-coordinate alignment. A cheaper pruned-full-inference diagnostic must be labeled separately because full-panel genotypes affected inferred ages/topology.

sampling_age_error.conditions: Independent reference-diploid Gaussian sampling-date errors SD25 and SD50 generations, shared across its two haplotypes, truncated to each declared active source era below census350; fixed noise seeds. Input dates only change; true genealogies/labels stay unchanged.
sampling_age_error.inference: Supply erroneous observed dates to Relate and all methods; do not repair inferred ages with true ages. Report invalid dates, inference/geometry failures and retain all paired attempts.
sampling_age_error.scope: Known reference sampling-date uncertainty only, not a general proof of robustness to internal coalescent-age error.

genotype_and_phase_error.conditions: Zero control, allele error0.001 on both reference/query observations, and phase-switch Poisson rate1 perMb perquery diploid. Fixed independent perturbation seeds.
genotype_and_phase_error.labels: Allele errors leave truth unchanged; save observed-haplotype permutation for phase errors and align external haplotype scoring labels accordingly. Never expose permutation to features. Report diploid dosage.

demographic_ood.condition: Separate modified model with Bronze admixture proportion YAM/NEO70/30 at otherwise unchanged140 generations, new independently simulated64 parents and full4-source census labels.
demographic_ood.scope: Disclosed demographic shift, no unmodified-model reproduction claim; paired candidate/baseline within each fresh regime parent, no pairing of different genealogies as identical chromosomes.

query_count.sampling: For each independent parent and draw, hash-rank32query diploids using no labels. First8diploids form fixed focal16haplotypes, next8 and next16 form nested panels. Score identical focal coordinates/labels across counts.
query_count.workflow1: Post-inference interface study: infer once with all64query haplotypes+24refs, prune/canonicalize the observed inferred genealogy to16/32/64queries+same refs and recompute observed features/geometry. Full64query genotype information influenced inference in every count.
query_count.workflow2: End-to-end availability study: rerun Relate separately using only16/32/64observedquery haplotypes+same24refs, observed sample ages, synthetic map and ancestral polarization at exported observed sites. Other query genotypes and labels are unavailable. Score same focal16.
query_count.contrast: Candidate-minus-baseline paired NLL and difference-in-differences for Q64 versusQ16, separately per inference workflow. Average4draws and3seed losses within parent before uncertainty.
query_count.multiplicity: Separate two-contrast family, Holm alpha0.05 for the2workflow difference-in-differences. All intermediateQ32 estimates and individual-method gains descriptive. Parent bootstrap retains every paired count/draw/seed.
query_count.scope: Fixed models trained onQ64, so this is prespecified zero-shot panel-size response, not separately trained Q-specific learning curves.64parents may yield imprecise conclusions.

conditions: 4tiles*64anchors versus8tiles*32 versus16tiles*16, matched source density256 perMb
8tiles with25000bp observed context extension, common central readouts
finite_source_and_tile_sensitivity.coordinates: Same physical units/rates/readout points and focal queries. No source added from target readouts.
finite_source_and_tile_sensitivity.scope: Descriptive paired uncertainty and cost/source-coverage diagnostics, no anchor-refinement or tile-invariance claim.

separate_prespecified_analyses.uncertainty: Parent-level paired intervals for every condition with the full condition/draw/seed vector resampled together. Conditions sharing mother chromosomes are dependent, not extra parents.
separate_prespecified_analyses.multiplicity_policy: Reference/age/error/demographic/tile results are separately prespecified descriptive analyses with labeled unadjusted intervals and no confirmatory superiority claims. Query-count inferential family is explicit and separate. If making additional claims, amend before any robustness data generation and allocate a separate family.

planning_estimates_not_measurements.cpu_preparation_reserve: 1–3days, observed native inference was fast but packaging/eigensystem/caches dominate; benchmark new parent batches before committing all writes.
planning_estimates_not_measurements.gpu_training_reserve: Approximately300–600 GPU-hours for up to192starts, order1–2weeks with2free GPUs; extrapolation, not throughput guarantee. Wider models or48epochs can exceed estimate. Freeze or revise development compute budget before any test generation.
planning_estimates_not_measurements.memory: Pilot anchor peak0.97GB at20parent bank. Transfer/cache lazily in batches if larger bank exceeds a predeclared per-job50GB GPU allocation; preserve numerical/model behavior and QA before lock.
planning_estimates_not_measurements.robustness_cache_cap_scope: At most12full-size64parent condition-equivalents simultaneously materialized. There are more paired draws/workflows than12 conditions, so process inference/geometry/prediction batches and reconstruct sealed rebuildable caches as needed.

resources.storage_policy: Preflight projected bytes per stage/batch, stop bulk writes at450GBwarning. Never exceed500GB total including environment. Do not create all dense oracle boundary/perturbation caches simultaneously. Keep raw inputs, manifests, logs and hash-bound predictions; root may remove only verified reproducible owned caches after recording reconstruction recipe. Storage pressure cannot select or drop test parents. The12condition-equivalent allowance is a simultaneous cache/staging cap, not permission to omit required paired draws or regimes. Preserve compact perturbed observations and all sealed predictions before deleting any rebuildable cache.

report_policy: Main manuscript emphasizes useful supported findings with uncertainty and scoped adaptations, including informative null/failure results. Complete research record preserves all criticism, failed runs, rejected/absent parents, candidate searches, contrasts and legacy results. A positive statistical outcome is neither acceptance nor a novelty verdict.
freeze_requirements: Root must turn this proposal into signed/hash-bound execution configs, cohort seed registry/admission code, selected model/checkpoint manifest and analysis script before any confirmatory or robustness generation. These files alone are not an executable freeze.
